name: De weddingplanners: van chaos naar champagne
original_name: De weddingplanners: van chaos naar champagne
overview: Weddings at the highest level. The Wedding Planners: From Chaos to Champagne is the brand-new high-end workplace reality series that takes viewers into the world of the Netherlands' leading wedding planners. During the turbulent wedding season, we follow four top organizers who leave nothing to chance as they create the most exclusive weddings. From weddings in fairytale castles in the Netherlands to sun-drenched ceremonies in Tuscany.
